field: One rice farmer work hard for im farm, as e de hope for better harvest.
birds: But bird dem keep de come chop the rice wey e plant.
guard: E guard the farm, but the bird dem return any time wey dem get chance.
plan: The farmer decide say e go use sense instead of to chase dem again.
animal: E kill one animal and put the animal intestine for on top im own belle.
still: Then e lie down for the farm and pretend say e don die.
watch: The bird dem watch the person wey no de move inside the rice.
quiet: The farmer wait without to move.
closer: As dem believe say e don die, the bird dem come near.
caught: When dem reach where im hand fit catch dem, e jump up catch dem.
safe: From that time, im rice farm safe from those bird dem.
title: The story title talk about the farmer im death, but na pretend e be de pretend.
lesson: The lesson na say to think well fit solve problem wey to chase only no fit solve.
end: Na so the rice farmer protect the harvest wey e work for.
